methods.label: Factor the difference of squares
methods.explanation:
The denominator is a difference of squares, so factoring avoids calculating the two large squares separately:
\[
252^2-248^2=(252-248)(252+248)=4\cdot500=2000.
\]
Therefore
\[
\frac{1000^2}{252^2-248^2}
=\frac{1{,}000{,}000}{2000}
=\boxed{500},
\]
which is choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the elementary difference-of-squares identity followed by integer arithmetic.

candidate.annotationRationale: Recognizing and applying the difference-of-squares identity is the central target. Arithmetic involving powers supports evaluation of the resulting quotient; polynomial multiplication is not required by the written method.

review.mathematicalCheck: The denominator equals (252-248)(252+248)=4·500=2000, so the quotient is 1,000,000/2000=500.
